about.title: Don’t just see it.
about.lead: Travel KG is a team of local travellers from Bishkek. We show Kyrgyzstan the way we love it ourselves.
about.text: Since 2016 we have been creating routes in all seven regions of the country: sleeping in yurts on summer pastures, crossing Tien Shan passes and introducing guests to nomadic culture. We walk every route ourselves before offering it.

reviews.title: Stories

items.name: Anna Melnikova
items.text: I thought I would just look at the mountains. Instead I came back feeling I had found a place I had been looking for all my life. A night in a yurt under the stars by the lake was the best moment of all my travels.

items.name: Aigerim Sadykova
items.text: A calm and beautiful route. Our guide showed us places you won’t find in any guidebook and made sure nobody got too tired.

items.name: Nikolay Petrov
items.text: We travelled as a family with two kids. Everything was thought through: transfers, meals, stops. The children still talk about the beach and the mountains on the horizon.

items.name: Madina Toktogulova
items.text: The red rocks at sunrise are unreal! Everything ran like clockwork: pick-up from the hotel, great food, back on time. I will definitely travel with you again.

items.name: Daniil Kim
items.text: A tough but incredible trek. The climb to the pass wasn’t easy, but the view of the turquoise lake made up for everything. I’d love a little more time to rest by the water.

items.name: Elmira Abdykadyrova
items.text: I loved the balance of history and nature. The caravanserai is impressive, and the night in yurts with dinner at a shepherd family’s home will stay with me for a long time.

items.name: Oksana Litvinenko
items.text: The trip was even more comfortable than I expected. The guides were attentive and full of stories. The Dungan mosque and the hot springs were a delight.

items.q: How do I book a tour?
items.a: Open the tour page, pick a date in the calendar, the number of travellers and the length of the trip. Then press “Book” and leave your contact details — a manager will confirm within two hours.

items.q: Do I have to pay straight away?
items.a: No. There is no prepayment: after confirmation we send you payment details, and you can pay by card, bank transfer or in cash on the day of the trip.
Yes. Cancellation is free up to 48 hours before the tour starts. After that we keep 30% of the price.

items.q: When is the best time to visit Kyrgyzstan?
items.a: High-altitude lakes (Son-Kul, Ala-Kul, Kel-Suu) are open from June to September. Issyk-Kul, Ala-Archa, Burana and Karakol are wonderful all year round.

items.q: Are the tours suitable for children?
items.a: Yes, routes marked “Easy” suit children aged 6 and over. The minimum age for hard treks is 14.

categoryText.mountains: Expect alpine meadows, glaciers and sweeping Tien Shan panoramas. The pace is relaxed, with plenty of stops for rest and photos, while your guide shares stories about the nature and history of the area.
categoryText.lakes: Kyrgyzstan’s mountain lakes mean crystal-clear water, silence and endless skies. We pick the best spots on the shore, and you stay in cosy yurts or guesthouses.
categoryText.trekking: A real hiking route with mountain passes and nights under the stars. We organise camping gear and meals — all you need to do is enjoy the trail.
categoryText.canyons: Fantastic red sandstone formations change colour throughout the day. The walks are easy, and the views are among the most photogenic in the country.
categoryText.adventures: A route for those who love movement and strong emotions. All equipment is checked, instructors are certified, and safety always comes first.
categoryText.nature: Forests, waterfalls and fresh mountain air. Easy walks suit the whole family, and local hosts welcome you with traditional hospitality.
categoryText.history: A journey along the Great Silk Road: ancient cities, stone statues and legends told by a historian guide.
categoryText.city: Discover modern Kyrgyzstan: green boulevards, monuments, museums and lively oriental bazaars.

answers.price: Prices range from 1,500 to 8,000 som per person. The tour page calculates the total instantly, and groups of 5 or more get 10% off.
answers.season: High-altitude lakes (Son-Kul, Kel-Suu, Ala-Kul) are open from June to September. Issyk-Kul, Ala-Archa, Burana and Karakol can be visited all year round. The tour calendar shows every available date.
answers.payment: No prepayment is needed. Once your booking is confirmed you can pay by card, bank transfer or in cash.
answers.booking: Open a tour, pick a date in the calendar, the number of travellers and the duration, then press “Book now” and leave your contact details. We confirm within 2 hours.
answers.cancel: Cancellation is free up to 48 hours before the tour. After that, 30% of the price is retained.
answers.contact: Call or message us on WhatsApp: {{phone}}, or email {{email}}. We are available daily from 9:00 to 21:00.
answers.kids: Easy routes are great for children aged 6+: Issyk-Kul, Ala-Archa, Skazka Canyon and Burana. Add your children’s ages in the booking comment.
